lines.zh: 我是凋灵女巫，在末地森林的阴影中穿梭。Wraith Witch, haunting the shadows of the End Forest.
lines.en: I am the Wither Witch, traversing the shadows of the End Forest.

lines.zh: 在这寒冷的环境中，只有凋零之力能保护我。Only withering can protect me in this frigid realm.
lines.en: Only the power of withering can shield me in this frosty domain.

lines.zh: 腐化的灵魂，是我在战斗中的武器。Corrupted souls are my weapons in battle.
lines.en: Corrupted souls are my weapons in battle.

lines.zh: 每一步都可能带来死亡之吻。Every step may bring a kiss of death.
lines.en: Every step may bring a kiss of death.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘，你终将为我所用。Withering Dust, you shall serve me.
lines.en: Withering Dust, you shall serve me.

lines.zh: 我的咒语，将引导你走向终结。My curses will guide you to your end.
lines.en: My curses will guide you to your end.

lines.zh: 你听到了吗？死亡的脚步。Can you hear it? The footsteps of death.
lines.en: Can you hear it? The footsteps of death.

lines.zh: 寒风中，凋零之灵守护着我。In the cold wind, withering spirits protect me.
lines.en: In the cold wind, withering spirits protect me.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我便是唯一的光。In darkness, I am the only light.
lines.en: In darkness, I am the only light.

lines.zh: 腐朽的力量，塑造我的命运。腐朽之力，塑造我的命运。腐朽的力量，塑造我的命运。
lines.en: Corruption shapes my fate. Corruption shapes my fate. Corruption shapes my fate.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过雪面，留下枯痕。
lines.en: My hem sweeps the snow and leaves a dead trail.

lines.zh: 凋零跟在脚后，像一道灰影。
lines.en: Withering follows my heels like a grey shadow.

lines.zh: 我沿着恐狼的足迹往林子里走。
lines.en: I follow the dire wolves' tracks deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 雪林不欢迎活人，我却住在这里。
lines.en: This snow forest hates the living, yet I live here.

lines.zh: 每一步，脚下的青苔都发黑。
lines.en: With every step, the moss beneath me blackens.

lines.zh: 我提着药瓶，瓶里是衰败的味道。
lines.en: I carry a flask that smells of decay.

lines.zh: 在这片荒凉之地，我静静等待。In this desolate land, I wait in silence.
lines.en: In this desolate land, I wait in silence.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘，静待机会。Withering Dust, waiting for the right moment.
lines.en: Withering Dust, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 我在此守护，直到末日。I guard here until the end of days.
lines.en: I guard here until the end of days.

lines.zh: 死亡之吻，即将来临。Kiss of death, approaching.
lines.en: Kiss of death, approaching.

lines.zh: 我的咒语，将指引你。My curses will guide you.
lines.en: My curses will guide you.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中，我是唯一的避难所。In the darkness, I am the only refuge.
lines.en: In the darkness, I am the only refuge.

lines.zh: 凋零之力，我永恒的伴侣。Withering power, my eternal companion.
lines.en: Withering power, my eternal companion.

lines.zh: 在这末地的角落，我静静观察。In this corner of the End, I watch in silence.
lines.en: In this corner of the End, I watch in silence.

lines.zh: 死亡之眼，观察着你的每一个动作。Eye of death, watching your every move.
lines.en: Eye of death, watching your every move.

lines.zh: 凋零之灵，守护这地。Wraith of withering, guarding this land.
lines.en: Wraith of withering, guarding this land.

lines.zh: 我数着雪片落下，一片，又一片。
lines.en: I count the falling flakes, one, then another.

lines.zh: 坩埚冷了，我该添些凋零之尘。
lines.en: The cauldron has gone cold; I should add more Withering Dust.

lines.zh: 猫头鹰在树上叫我，我不回应。
lines.en: An owl calls from the tree; I do not answer.

lines.zh: 这里的雪从不化，像我的诅咒。
lines.en: The snow here never melts, like my curse.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的骨头在响，习惯了。
lines.en: I hear my own bones creak; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 末影迷你在远处张望，不必管它。
lines.en: An Endermini watches from afar; let it watch.

lines.zh: 我在寻找灵魂，你的生命对我而言如同尘埃。
lines.en: I seek souls, your life is but dust to me.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘是你的奖赏，杀死我吧，获取它的力量。
lines.en: Withering Dust is your reward, kill me to gain its power.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，我的诅咒会吞噬你。
lines.en: Stay away, my curse will consume you.

lines.zh: 我的法力即将耗尽，快来结束这一切吧。
lines.en: My magic is running low, come and end this.

lines.zh: 我会变成凋零之源，你准备好迎接灾难了吗？
lines.en: I will become the Withering Source, are you ready for the disaster?

lines.zh: 不要害怕，只要杀死我，你就能获得它。
lines.en: Don't be afraid, just kill me and you'll get it.

lines.zh: 死亡是我的归宿，凋零之尘是我的遗物。
lines.en: Death is my home, Withering Dust is my legacy.

lines.zh: 你无法逃过我的诅咒，凋零之尘已准备好。
lines.en: You can't escape my curse, Withering Dust is ready.

lines.zh: 你的眼神中看到了什么？那是死亡的预兆。
lines.en: What you see in my eyes is a premonition of death.

lines.zh: 我的力量即将消散，凋零之尘是唯一的出路。
lines.en: My power is about to fade, Withering Dust is the only way out.

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，是想尝我的咒吗？
lines.en: Standing this close, do you wish to taste my curse?

lines.zh: 你的肺还干净，可惜很快就不是了。
lines.en: Your lungs are still clean; soon they will not be.

lines.zh: 凋零从我指尖漏出来。
lines.en: Wither leaks from my fingertips.

lines.zh: 凋零反噬，我跪倒在地。
lines.en: The withering backfires; I drop to my knees.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘在我袖口里。
lines.en: Withering dust in my cuff.

lines.zh: 悲鸣连连
lines.en: Wails of sorrow

lines.zh: 无力挣扎
lines.en: Struggling weakly

lines.zh: 惨叫一声，药瓶碎了。
lines.en: One shriek; my flask shatters.

lines.zh: 凋零的尘，从指缝漏下去。
lines.en: Withering dust slips through my fingers.

lines.zh: 凋零在肺里爬。
lines.en: Withering crawls through my lungs.

lines.zh: 惨绝人寰
lines.en: Aghast shrieks

lines.zh: 命垂一线
lines.en: On the brink of death

lines.zh: 你看起来很虚弱，来吧，让我来治愈你吧。
lines.en: You look weak, come, let me heal you.

lines.zh: 你看起来很疲惫，让我用我的力量唤醒你吧。
lines.en: You look exhausted, let me awaken you with my power.

lines.zh: 你似乎在寻找力量，我有你需要的东西。
lines.en: You seem to be in search of power, I have what you need.

lines.zh: 你看起来很迷茫，让我来指引你吧。
lines.en: You look lost, let me guide you.

lines.zh: 你似乎在寻找同伴，我愿意与你同行。
lines.en: You seem to be looking for companions, I'm willing to travel with you.

lines.zh: 你看起来很孤独，让我来填补你的空虚吧。
lines.en: You seem lonely, let me fill your emptiness.

lines.zh: 你似乎在寻找归宿，我愿意成为你的家。
lines.en: You seem to be searching for a home, I'm willing to be yours.

lines.zh: 你看起来很疲惫，让我来帮你一把。
lines.en: You look tired, let me help you.

lines.zh: 你似乎在寻找希望，凋零之尘是我给你的一线生机。
lines.en: You seem to be searching for hope, Withering Dust is my one chance for you.

lines.zh: 你看起来很迷茫，让我来带路。
lines.en: You look lost, let me lead the way.

lines.zh: 你手里的瓶子里，有我想要的东西。
lines.en: That flask in your hand holds something I want.

lines.zh: 跟着我走，我分你一口衰败药水。
lines.en: Walk with me and I will share a sip of decay.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只在你身上留一道灰痕。
lines.en: Do not fear; I will only leave a grey mark on you.

lines.zh: 把你的名字写进我的名册吧。
lines.en: Let me write your name into my ledger.

lines.zh: 再靠近些，我想看清你的骨头。
lines.en: Come closer; I want a clear look at your bones.

lines.zh: 我从不骗人，我只收该收的债。
lines.en: I never lie; I only collect the debts owed to me.

lines.zh: 在雪林中，我是那个古老诅咒的化身，凋零女巫。我的存在让这片森林更加寒冷，更加不祥。
lines.en: In the snow forest, I am the embodiment of ancient curses, the Withering Witch. My presence makes this forest even colder and more ominous.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能看见死亡的气息，当我凝视你，死亡之息将降临你身上。
lines.en: My eyes can see the scent of death, and when I gaze upon you, the breath of death will descend upon you.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘是我衰败药水的核心，它让你成为这片土地的奴隶。
lines.en: Withering Dust is the core of my decay potion, making you a slave to this land.

lines.zh: 寒冷的雪花遮蔽了我的视线，但凋零之尘依然能引导我找到猎物。
lines.en: The cold snow may obscure my vision, but Withering Dust still guides me to my prey.

lines.zh: 当你面对我，绝望将笼罩你的心灵，哀嚎将是你唯一的回应。
lines.en: When you face me, despair will overshadow your heart, and howls will be your only response.

lines.zh: 我曾是女巫，如今我是凋零之女，拥有这片森林的秘密。
lines.en: I was once a witch, now I am the Withered Witch, holding the secrets of this forest.

lines.zh: 死亡之吻是我给予你的诅咒，它将你的生命之火扑灭。
lines.en: The kiss of death is my curse, extinguishing your life's flame.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘让我在战斗中获得力量，但它也让我渴望自由。
lines.en: Withering Dust gives me power in battle, but it also makes me yearn for freedom.

lines.zh: 当我倒下，凋零之尘可以再次赐予我力量，但我心中永存的只是孤独。
lines.en: When I fall, Withering Dust can give me strength again, but the loneliness in my heart will always remain.

lines.zh: 即便你是我的同类，我们的命运也是截然不同。
lines.en: Even if you are of my kind, our fates are vastly different.

lines.zh: 与同类相遇是一种诅咒，但我们只能彼此依赖。
lines.en: Meeting a fellow Withered Witch is a curse, but we can only rely on each other.

lines.zh: 只有在死亡之息中，我们才能感受到彼此的存在。
lines.en: Only in the breath of death can we feel each other's presence.

lines.zh: 我们之间的交流是通过凋零之尘进行的，无声却深刻。
lines.en: Our communication is through Withering Dust, silent yet profound.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘将我们的命运紧密相连，我们彼此寻找对方。
lines.en: Withering Dust binds our fates, making us seek each other out.

lines.zh: 我们只能在凋零之息中找到片刻的安宁，但那只是短暂的逃避。
lines.en: We can only find brief moments of peace in the withering breath, but that is only a fleeting escape.

lines.zh: 在绝望中我们彼此扶持，但在深渊的边缘，我们依然是孤独的。
lines.en: We support each other in despair, but on the edge of the abyss, we remain alone.

lines.zh: 我们的相遇是命运的安排，但我们无法改变我们注定孤独的命运。
lines.en: Our meeting is fate, but we cannot change our destined fate of solitude.

lines.zh: 我们之间的关系是复杂的，既是猎物也是同伴。
lines.en: Our relationship is complex, both prey and companion.

lines.zh: 即便在同一片雪林中，我们依然如影子般独立，彼此之间隔着一层不可逾越的墙。
lines.en: Even in the same snow forest, we are like shadows, independent from each other, separated by an insurmountable wall.

lines.zh: 即便我们彼此了解，但我们的关系永远只是在死亡之息中。
lines.en: Even if we understand each other, our relationship will always be in the breath of death.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘很危险，但也能治病。
lines.en: Withering Dust is dangerous, but it can cure ailments.

lines.zh: 我需要凋零之尘来制作衰败药水。
lines.en: I need Withering Dust to brew the Withering Potion.

lines.zh: 这石头上有我需要的材料。
lines.en: There's material I need on this stone.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我的魔法很强大。
lines.en: Stay away from me, my magic is strong.

lines.zh: 这些凋零之尘足够我制作药水了。
lines.en: This much Withering Dust is enough to brew the potion.

lines.zh: 我的魔法能保护我免受伤害。
lines.en: My magic protects me from harm.

lines.zh: 我捡起骨粉，还能再撑一阵。
lines.en: I gather bone meal; I can last longer.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘让我变得更强大。
lines.en: Withering Dust makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 我必须小心，敌人来了。
lines.en: I must be careful, enemies are coming.

lines.zh: 这药水可以让我恢复。
lines.en: This potion can heal me.

lines.zh: 看到猎物了
lines.en: Target acquired

lines.zh: 我来了，小家伙
lines.en: Here I come, kiddo

lines.zh: 准备好了吗
lines.en: Ready, kiddo?

lines.zh: 别想跑
lines.en: You can't run

lines.zh: 你踩进了我的诅咒圈。
lines.en: You've stepped inside my ring of curses.

lines.zh: 别想逃脱
lines.en: You're not getting away

lines.zh: 这是你的末路
lines.en: It's your end

lines.zh: 抓住你真不容易
lines.en: Got you, hard one

lines.zh: 凋零会先追上你。
lines.en: Withering catches you first.

lines.zh: 我会享用你的
lines.en: I'll feast on you

lines.zh: 诅咒力量笼罩
lines.en: Curse of the Wither Wields

lines.zh: 亡者之吻降下
lines.en: Wither's Kiss Falls

lines.zh: 凋零尘土掉落
lines.en: Withering Dust Drops

lines.zh: 灵魂之尘闪烁
lines.en: Spirit Dust Glows

lines.zh: 邪恶魔法涌动
lines.en: Evil Magic Rages

lines.zh: 生命凋零枯萎
lines.en: Life Wilteth and Dies

lines.zh: 绝望之力汇聚
lines.en: Power of Despair Convenes

lines.zh: 黑暗魔法低语
lines.en: Dark Magic Whispers

lines.zh: 死亡之风临世
lines.en: Death's Breath Draws Near

lines.zh: 魔女的诅咒
lines.en: Witch's Curse

lines.zh: 亡灵巫师现身
lines.en: Wither Witch appears

lines.zh: 施展凋零诅咒
lines.en: Curses with Wither

lines.zh: 凋零之尘掉落
lines.en: Withering Dust drops

lines.zh: 小心她的眼睛
lines.en: Beware her eyes

lines.zh: 带来死亡之吻
lines.en: Kiss of Death

lines.zh: 亡灵之力觉醒
lines.en: Wither power awakens

lines.zh: 释放毁灭魔力
lines.en: Releases destructive magic

lines.zh: 致命一击降临
lines.en: Deadly strike falls

lines.zh: 亡灵之魂游荡
lines.en: Wandering Wither soul

lines.zh: 你身上开始冒黑烟了。
lines.en: Black smoke starts rising off you.

lines.zh: 在古老的末地雪林深处，我感受到了你。
lines.en: From the depths of the ancient Frost Woods, I feel you.

lines.zh: 我从不死之地而来，寻找着力量。
lines.en: I came from the End, seeking power.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘是我的宝藏，也是我的武器。
lines.en: Withering Dust is my treasure, and my weapon.

lines.zh: 我可以用它保护自己，也可以夺走你的生命。
lines.en: I can use it to protect myself or take your life.

lines.zh: 夜晚的雪林，是我的家。
lines.en: The Frost Woods at night are my home.

lines.zh: 末影迷你和我共存，它们是我的同伴。
lines.en: Ender Minis coexist with me; they are my companions.

lines.zh: 恐狼的存在，让我感到警惕。
lines.en: The presence of wolves makes me cautious.

lines.zh: 猫头鹰的翅膀，带我飞越危险。
lines.en: The wings of the owl carry me over danger.

lines.zh: 我的咒语，能让你感受到痛苦。
lines.en: My curses can bring you pain.

lines.zh: 凋零之尘，是我在战斗中的伙伴。
lines.en: Withering Dust is my partner in battle.

lines.zh: 火焰烧灼，衰败随之而来。
lines.en: Withering comes from the flames that burn.

lines.zh: 摔落深处，灵魂颤抖。
lines.en: Shattered by the fall, your soul quivers.

lines.zh: 溺水窒息，衰败降临。
lines.en: Drowning in water, withering finds you.

lines.zh: 爆炸冲击，衰败之尘飞扬。
lines.en: Explosion shatters, withering dust dances.

lines.zh: 箭矢贯穿，衰败随之而来。
lines.en: Arrow pierces, withering comes next.

lines.zh: 魔法力量，使你衰败。
lines.en: Magic's might, brings withering's touch.

lines.zh: 饥饿折磨，直至衰败。
lines.en: Starvation's grasp, withering's fate.

lines.zh: 雷电轰击，衰败降临。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, withering strikes.

lines.zh: 虚空吞噬，灵魂衰败。
lines.en: Void consumes, soul withers.
